Oh My Girl
episodes.overview: OH MY GIRL is back on Men on a Mission with their new song, “Summer Comes!” As each of the members show off their unique charms and compete for the position of the face of the group, the members of Men on a Mission become the girls’ supporters to cheer them on. Later on, Senior Dong prepares a feast for the girls.

episodes.name: ITZY
episodes.overview: ITZY is back on Men on a Mission with their new album, “KILL MY DOUBT.” Every member is welcome back, and they are more charming than ever. Competing with the members of Men on a Mission, ITZY proves how skillful they are in many things. Stay tuned for charm, fun, and more!

episodes.name: Kwon Il Yong, Pyo Chang Won, Park Ji Yoon, Jang Dong Min
DinDin, GOT7 BamBam, RalRal & woo!ah! Nana
episodes.overview: DinDin talks about the show he recently joined. While talking about it, he gets cornered because of his height. Ralral reenacts a couple of her famous clips on her channel. She tells us how she became a YouTuber. BamBam shows off his charms in word-playing games, and Nana shows her love for the show. Stay tuned to check out!

episodes.name: Kim Soo Mi, Jung Jun Ha, Yoon Hyun Min, Yura
episodes.overview: The cast of “Marrying the Mafia: Returns” joins this episode. Soo Mi talks about the difficulties she had while shooting the movie. Jun Ha talks about the efforts he made at the scene to lighten the mood. Yura is back as an actress, and she shows off her unexpected charms. Hyun Min talks about how he became an actor when he used to play baseball as a pro.

episodes.name: The Chuseok Special Begins
episodes.overview: Many familiar faces join the show for the Chuseok special. Alongside the familiar faces, there are some idol members too. Kep1er, ZEROBASEONE, and Yerin come together for a fun time. Athletes are a guest on the show this week as well. Speedskater Mo Tae Beom, pitcher Yoo Hee Kwan, and professional swimmer Jung You In are here to provide some athletic expertise.

episodes.name: 2023 Knowing Bros Wrestling Competition
episodes.overview: The Chuseok special continues this week, and there are many fun games to play. After playing games on the train, they move to the ssireum field. Ssireum competition is back to celebrate Chuseok, and there are many special guests invited. Some players are known for their ssireum skills, but rookie players show their unexpected skills as well. Stay tuned!

episodes.name: Kang Soo-jung, Son Jun-ho, Jo Jung-sik, Lee Na-yeon, Kim Jong-jin, Jeong Keun-woo, Han Suk-joon, Lee Seung-hyun
episodes.overview:
Yonsei Versus Korea University

Celebrities who graduated from the prestigious rival schools are here! Kang Soo Jung, Son Jun Ho, Jo Jung Sik, and Lee Nayeon, who went to Yonsei University, compete against Korea University grads Kim Jong Jin, Jeong Keun Woo, Han Suk Joon, and Lee Seung Hyun in a battle of brain and brawn. Which team will come out on top? Stay tuned to find out.

episodes.name: Hwang Soo-kyung, g.o.d Joon Park, ZEROBASEONE Zhang Hao & Matthew Seok, n.SSign Eddie, Sugar Lee Ayumi, SECRET NUMBER Dita, BLACKSWAN Fatou, Billlie Tsuki & KISS OF LIFE Natty
episodes.overview:
Brother Korean Competition with Global K-Pop Idols

This week, Men on a Mission hosts the Brother Korean Competition with K-Pop idols from all over the world. Some have been in Korea longer than others, but their love for Korean culture and language are all the same. As Team Global Idols and Team Brother competes against each other, the competition becomes heated up.

episodes.overview:
The Leaders of “Street Woman Fighter 2”

The leaders of “Street Woman Fighter 2” join Men on a Mission this week! These amazing dancers who each represent their crew from the dance competition come to tell the viewers about behind the scenes stories and show off their incredible dance moves. Stay tuned to be amazed and moved by their stories and performances.

episodes.name: Park Ki-young, Big Mama, Ailee, Parc Jae-jung, Lee Mu-jin
episodes.overview:
Knowing Singers

This week, some legendary singers spanning various generations join Men on a Mission. From Bigmama, the group that has perfect harmony and members who are all professors, to Lee Mu Jin, the young singing sensation, as well as Park Ki Young, Park Jae Jung, and Ailee, this episode is full of amazing performances and interesting stories.

episodes.name: Kim Shin-young, Shim Jin-hwa, Kim Ki-wook, Hwang Young-jin
episodes.overview:
Celebrating 20 Years with 4 SBS Comedians

Four comedians who debuted on SBS twenty years ago join Men on a Mission this week. As Kim Shin Young, Shim Jin Hwa, Kim Gi Wook, and Hwang Young Jin celebrate their comedy careers, they talk about their greatest and funniest moments from the past. Don’t miss the fun games they play to show off their talent as well.

episodes.name: 2023 Brother School Closing Ceremony
episodes.overview: It is this year’s Brother School Closing Ceremony as the Men on a Mission members invite several special guests to celebrate the end of the year together. With glamorous idol guests to their festive performances, this episode of full of joy. Stay tuned to watch the fun games and the Men on a Mission’s very own end of the year awards ceremony.
